submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 5.7mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.088% at 100 GeV. This was determined through systematic simulation: initial comparison at 5mm showed F3 (3.2%) outperformed F2 (3.9%) and F1 (5.1%). Subsequent thickness optimization scanning from 3-7mm identified 5.7mm as optimal for F3. The material's short radiation length (relative=1, compared to 2 and 3 for F2 and F1) minimizes activation, enabling hands-on maintenance during shutdowns as required.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Final optimized resolution of 3.088% at 100 GeV with Absorber-F3 at 5.7mm thickness, better than all other tested configurations

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) evaluated in the study

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F3 has the shortest radiation length (relative=1) among candidates, resulting in lowest activation levels and enabling hands-on maintenance
Recommended thickness of 5.7mm is within the specified 2-10mm range
